sources.snippet: Anime Face Detector This is an anime face detector with facial landmark estimation, implemented in plain PyTorch. The face detectors (Faster R-CNN and YOLOv3) and the landmark model (HRNetV2, 28 points) were originally trained with mmdetection and mmpose; since v0.1.0 this package runs them without any OpenMMLab runtime dependency.
